name: Derek Han
lead: High school senior having fun with his engineering skills. Creatively solved some problems along the way.
about: A quote, though modified, that I like is
I chose to build my wind tunnel and many other things in the past years not because they are easy, but because I thought they were easy.

That was basically how I approached my projects: started naïvely, encountered too many problems, and persisted through some. Nevertheless, all of them were projects of great fun and learning opportunities

And, to be honest, who can say the race to the moon wasn't that? They practically sailed across the atlantic on a washing machine, but came back with tons of knowledge learned. I should do the same. Engineering projects in high school, if not anytime, is at least 50% for the learning.
